entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: The floating pirate city at the heart of the Brazen Coalition on Ixalan, built from entangled ships and rafts.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where High and Dry floats.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate society centered on High and Dry, based on favors and obligations.

entities.name: Scourge
entities.description: Captain Beckett Brass's ship, which became entangled with the Squid Eyes.

entities.name: Squid Eyes
entities.description: Jareth Wake's ship, which became entangled with the Scourge.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: Captain of the Scourge and co-founder of High and Dry, later Admiral and Governor.

entities.name: Jareth Wake
entities.description: Navigator of the Squid Eyes and co-founder of High and Dry.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who fled to High and Dry after killing Isperia.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A companion of Vraska at High and Dry.

entities.name: Amelia
entities.description: A companion of Vraska at High and Dry.

entities.name: Malcolm Lee
entities.description: A companion of Vraska at High and Dry.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war during which Vraska stayed at High and Dry.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion that sent refugees to High and Dry and led to its siege.

entities.name: Bluecoats
entities.description: The force used to enforce law in Brass's pirate nation.

events.summary: The ships Scourge and Squid Eyes collide and tangle; Brass and Wake agree a truce and found High and Dry.
events.quote: agreeing to a truce when their ships became locked together

events.summary: After killing Isperia, Vraska flees to High and Dry and spends the start of the War of the Spark there.
events.quote: After killing Isperia , Vraska fled to High and Dry to recuperate.

events.summary: High and Dry swells with refugees during the New Phyrexian Invasion and is besieged.
events.quote: they found themselves unable to survive without its vast supply stores and returned to find it besieged

events.summary: Admiral Brass leads the fight to reclaim High and Dry, driving out the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Admiral Brass led the fight to reclaim the city, driving out the Phyrexians and reestablishing order.

events.summary: Brass declares the age of piracy over and becomes Governor of a new pirate nation seated at High and Dry.
events.quote: She assumed the title of Governor

relations.note: The floating city lies at the heart of the Coalition.
relations.quote: High and Dry is the floating city at the heart of the Brazen Coalition on the plane of Ixalan .

relations.note: Governor using it as her seat of power.
relations.quote: used High and Dry as her seat of power
